reason: A DeepSeek Harness UI customization plugin providing selectable skins, configurable wallpapers, and a draggable desktop pet with preferences persisted locally.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可切换皮肤、自定义壁纸和可拖拽桌宠，并在浏览器本地保存相关偏好。
summaries.en: Adds selectable skins, configurable wallpapers, and a draggable desktop pet to DeepSeek Harness while storing related preferences locally in the browser.

capabilities: Registers and applies selectable UI color themes
Displays user-selected local images or user-provided media URLs as wallpapers
Persists visual preferences and pet position in browser localStorage
Adds a draggable desktop pet whose mood reflects the agent's running state
